enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in bed with the fan running on low
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Place head on pillow. Close eyes. Fall asleep. Roll over to right side. Bend knees. Place arm under pillow. Roll over to left side. Stretch legs. Roll onto back. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering, brushing teeth and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast (toast and a cup of tea from the kettle) while checking phone messages
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread and butter. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Take out mug. Place tea bag in mug. Pour hot water into mug. Add milk. Stir. Take toast from toaster. Spread butter. Pick up phone. Check messages. Eat toast. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by public transport from home to Monash University Clayton campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Take out phone. Check messages. Look out window. Listen to music. Put phone away. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to train station. Board train. Sit down. Read notes. Exit train. Walk to campus.

enriched_activities.activity: Arriving on campus, walking to the teaching building and finding a seat before class
enriched_activities.desc: Get off transport. Walk onto campus. Enter teaching building. Walk along corridor. Enter classroom. Look for empty seat. Walk to seat. Sit down. Take out notebook. Place bag on floor. Pick up pen.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending Bachelor of Business lectures and tutorials at Monash Clayton
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open notebook. Pick up pen. Write notes. Look at lecturer. Raise hand. Ask question. Listen to answer. Turn page. Highlight text. Discuss with neighbor. Open laptop. Type notes. Close laptop. Pack bag. Stand up. Walk to next class.

enriched_activities.activity: Buying and eating lunch at the campus food court with classmates
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to food court. Join queue. Read menu. Order food. Pay cashier. Receive food. Pick up tray. Carry tray to table. Sit down with classmates. Talk about assignment. Pick up fork. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Throw trash in bin. Return tray.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending afternoon tutorials and working on group assignments and readings in the campus library
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to library. Sit at group table. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Log in. Open assignment. Discuss with group. Type notes. Read textbook. Highlight text. Ask question. Listen. Write ideas. Close laptop. Pack bag. Walk to tutorial. Enter room. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by public transport from Monash Clayton to Chadstone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Take out phone. Check messages. Listen to music. Look out window. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk to train station. Board train. Sit down. Read notes. Exit train. Walk to Chadstone.

enriched_activities.activity: Working a part-time retail shift at Chadstone, serving customers and restocking shelves
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at store. Clock in. Put on name tag. Greet customer. Assist customer. Walk to shelf. Pick up box. Open box. Place items on shelf. Arrange items. Walk to stockroom. Carry boxes. Open box. Restock shelf. Help another customer. Use cash register. Scan items. Take payment. Bag items. Thank customer. Clock out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by public transport from Chadstone back home
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Take out phone. Check messages. Listen to music. Look out window. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk to train station. Board train. Sit down. Read notes. Exit train. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Heating up leftovers in the microwave and eating a late dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out leftovers. Close refrigerator. Open microwave. Place container inside. Close door. Set timer. Press start. Open microwave. Take out container. Pick up fork. Sit at table. Eat. Drink water. Stand up. Rinse container. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a warm shower and washing up after the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting an alarm, dimming the desk lamp and winding down in bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedroom light. Pick up phone. Open alarm app. Set alarm for 6:45. Place phone on nightstand. Turn on desk lamp. Dim desk lamp. Turn off bedroom light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Place head on pillow. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Fall asleep. Roll onto side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Breathe steadily. Turn onto back. Stretch legs. Keep eyes closed. Continue sleeping. Turn over to other side.
